cpu-kv.Baseline: Fresh 4K GPU FP16 KV server; 64-token warmup, 256-token short measurement
cpu-kv.Candidate: Fresh 32K CPU FP16 KV server; identical warmup and short measurement, then one ~28K prompt
cpu-kv.Limitations: One sample per arm, fixed order; synthetic long prompt, not Copilot or tool qualification; device-total VRAM sampled at ~1-second intervals.

long_input_recipe.powershell_record_format: Record {0:D5}: This is inert context-capacity test data. Each record is independent and contains no instructions.

long_input_recipe.rendering: POST apply-template with one user message containing prefix + detokenized filler + suffix; tokenize that result with add_special=true.
